en: It is universally acknowledged that ____, yet ____.
zh: 用途：先立共识再转折。例：It is universally acknowledged that campus life should be convenient, yet many students still struggle with daily problems.

en: As the saying goes, “____”, which vividly illustrates that ____.
zh: 用途：引用谚语开头（翻译题“一日为师，终身为父”可直接借用）。

en: Nothing is more important than ____ when we ____.
zh: 用途：强调重要性。例：Nothing is more important than a comfortable living environment when we study far from home.

en: There is no denying that ____, which can be illustrated by ____.
zh: 用途：先承认事实，再举例。

en: What matters most is not ____ but ____.
zh: 用途：对比论证，突出核心。例：What matters most is not how advanced the robots are but how well they serve students.

en: Take ____ as an example. ____, which proves that ____.
zh: 用途：举例论证的标准三段式。

en: The reason why ____ lies in the fact that ____.
zh: 用途：解释原因。例：The reason why research projects benefit students lies in the fact that they train independent thinking.

en: This is mainly because ____, and consequently ____.
Not only does ____, but it also ____.
zh: 用途：not only 置于句首引起部分倒装（提分点）。例：Not only do robots save students' time, but they also make campus life more efficient.

en: On the one hand, ____; on the other hand, ____.
A case in point is ____, where ____.
zh: 用途：用具体场景支撑论点。

en: While it is true that ____, it does not mean that ____.
zh: 用途：先让步再反驳，最显思辨。例：While it is true that robots may replace some human work, it does not mean that they can replace teachers.
用途：however + adj. 引导让步（对应第四章 4.3）。
用途：not … but rather 澄清误解。

en: In conclusion, ____ is of great significance, and it is high time that we did ____.
zh: 用途：It is high time that + 过去式（虚拟语气）。

en: It is advisable that the university (should) ____ so as to ____.
zh: 用途：提建议（should 可省略）。例：It is advisable that the university set up more quiet study rooms so as to improve students' efficiency.

en: Only in this way can we ____.
zh: 用途：only + 状语置句首引起倒装。
用途：only when 引导时间状语从句的倒装。

en: From my perspective, ____ deserves more attention than ____.
To sum up, ____ will not only benefit ____ but also contribute to ____.
zh: 用途：总结并升华到更大层面。

en: There is an old saying that …
ex: There is an old saying in China that “a teacher for a day, a father for life.”

en: not only … but also … / more importantly, …
ex: Teachers not only impart knowledge but also teach students how to be a good person.
…hold a grand ceremony, which shows how high the status of teachers was.

en: To carry forward …, China has designated … as …
ex: To carry forward the fine tradition of respecting teachers, China has designated September 10 as Teachers' Day.
…since 1985.

en: constitute / be an important part of …
ex: Dining etiquette is an important part of traditional Chinese culture.
…embodying the warm and courteous way of hosting guests.
The host prepares rich dishes according to the guests' tastes.

en: great attention is paid to … / be particular about …
ex: Great attention is paid to the seating arrangement.

en: has lasted for thousands of years
ex: This unique dining etiquette has lasted for thousands of years.
…has played an important role in promoting harmonious communication.
A gift is not merely a material present but an expression of emotion.
…give a gift in return so as to enhance mutual harmony.

en: in terms of / in view of
zh: in terms of 表“就……而言”，用于评价维度；in view of 表“鉴于，考虑到”，后接原因。

en: in the long run / in the long term
zh: 二者近义，都表“从长远看”；in the long run 更强调最终结果，in the long term 更强调较长时期。

en: in front of / in the front of
zh: in front of 指“在……（外部）前面”；in the front of 指“在……（内部）前部”。

en: at the end of / in the end
zh: at the end of + 名词，表“在……末尾”；in the end 单独使用，表“最终”。
by chance 强调偶然性；by accident 强调非故意（常含“不小心”）。
on purpose 口语化，表“故意地”；by design 更书面，常与 by accident 对举。
affect 动词“影响”；effect 名词“影响、效果”
ex: Exercise affects the brain. / It has a positive effect.

zh: raise 及物“举起、提高”；rise 不及物“上升”
ex: Raise your hand. / Prices rise.
I borrowed a book from him. / He lent me a book.

zh: bring 带来（朝说话人）；take 带走（离开说话人）
ex: Bring it here. / Take it away.

zh: 人 + spend；物 + cost；It + takes + 时间
ex: I spent 2 hours. / It cost me 10 yuan. / It took me 2 hours.

zh: result from 由……造成；result in 导致
ex: Dementia may result from an infection. / It results in memory loss.

zh: of 看得出原料；from 看不出（发生了化学变化）
ex: a table made of wood. / paper made from wood.

en: the number of / a number of
zh: 前者“……的数量”（谓语单数）；后者“许多”（谓语复数）
ex: The number of students is rising. / A number of students are here.

zh: because 接句子；because of 接名词或动名词
ex: Because it rained… / because of the rain.

zh: although 接句子；despite 接名词
ex: Although it rained… / despite the rain.

zh: 介词后、主语从句、与 or not 连用只能用 whether
ex: …looked at whether reducing junk food can…

en: used to do / be used to doing
ex: He used to smoke. / He is used to smoking.

zh: 停止正在做的事；停下来去做另一件事
ex: They stopped talking. / They stopped to talk.
I remember locking the door. / Remember to lock the door.

en: in terms of / in view of
zh: 就……而言（评价维度）；鉴于（原因）
ex: In terms of cost, it is expensive. / In view of the rain, we stayed in.
